The Division 2 story route

The Division 2 Story & Lore Reading Order

A spoiler-aware The Division 2 story and lore reading order, covering the games and official transmedia while separating confirmed sequence from overlapping material.

Use this The Division 2 lore guide as a chronology and reading route rather than a substitute for the games or published works. It places only the sequence confirmed by official material. When a source does not establish an exact internal order, this page says so instead of inventing one.

new york origin

1. The New York origin

Begin with the outbreak and first SHD deployment. New York Collapse belongs to the early New York story, but its annotated format is safest after completing the original game if you want game-linked discoveries unspoiled.

  1. Play

    Tom Clancy's The Division — original New York campaign

    Minor setup spoilers

    Start with the original campaign to establish Black Friday, the breakdown of New York and the second-wave SHD response.

    Archive records: Green Poison Outbreak · SHD Activation

    Sources: The Division 2 – State of the Game Recap: The Story So Far

  2. Read

    Tom Clancy's The Division: New York Collapse

    Read after the original campaign for the lowest spoiler risk

    Use this official companion for its early post-Black Friday survivor frame and April Kelleher starting point. It is not a real-world emergency manual.

    Archive records: Tom Clancy's The Division: New York Collapse · April Kelleher

    Sources: The Division: New York Collapse Announced, The Division: Broken Dawn Novel Explores Effects of Global Collapse

between the games

2. Between the games

These official transmedia works sit before The Division 2. Broken Dawn is explicitly in the months between the games; Remission is a Division 2 prequel, but the official product material does not give it a finer placement against Broken Dawn.

  1. Read

    Tom Clancy's The Division: Broken Dawn

    Major novel spoilers

    Read after the original game and before The Division 2 for April Kelleher's Midwest antiviral lead and the bridge into the Washington era.

    Archive records: Tom Clancy's The Division: Broken Dawn · Broken Dawn Antiviral Race

    Sources: The Division: Broken Dawn Novel Explores Effects of Global Collapse, Find Out More About The Division With The Books Of The Game

  2. Read

    Tom Clancy's The Division: Remission

    Minor setup spoilers

    Read as a Washington prequel before The Division 2. Treat it as parallel pre-game context rather than a source-proven fixed step before or after Broken Dawn.

    Archive records: Tom Clancy's The Division: Remission · Washington, D.C.

    Sources: Tom Clancy's The Division: Remission

  3. Read

    Tom Clancy's The Division: Extremis Malis

    Major prequel spoilers

    Place this last in the pre-Division 2 block: its published route connects directly to the SHD Network failure that opens the sequel.

    Archive records: Tom Clancy's The Division: Extremis Malis · Division Network Crisis

    Sources: Tom Clancy's The Division: Extremis Malis, Dark Horse Comics and Ubisoft Expand The Division's Lore

washington campaign

3. Washington campaign and Episodes

Play the core The Division 2 campaign before its Black Tusk counteroffensive, then use Episodes 1–3 in their official release and content order. Inside same-episode groups the archive does not invent a story order unless the source establishes one.

  1. Play

    Tom Clancy's The Division 2 — base campaign and Tidal Basin

    Major campaign spoilers

    This block covers the nationwide SHD Network crisis, the Black Tusk invasion of Washington and the Tidal Basin antiviral recovery.

    Archive records: Division Network Crisis · Black Tusk Siege of Washington · Tidal Basin

    Sources: The Division 2 – State of the Game Recap: The Story So Far

  2. Play

    Year One Episodes 1–3

    Major mission spoilers

    Continue through Episode 1's Manning National Zoo and Camp White Oak, Episode 2's Pentagon and DARPA Research Labs, and Episode 3's two Coney Island missions.

    Archive records: Manning National Zoo · Camp White Oak · The Pentagon · DARPA Research Labs · Coney Island Amusement Park · Coney Island Ballpark

    Sources: Intelligence Annex: Manning National Zoo & Camp White Oak, Intelligence Annex: The Pentagon & DARPA Research Labs, Episode 3: Coney Island Live Now!

  3. Reference

    The World of Tom Clancy's The Division

    Broad franchise context

    Use this official reference work after the core games when you want a high-level SHD, equipment and timeline companion rather than another narrative campaign.

    Archive records: The World of Tom Clancy's The Division · Strategic Homeland Division

    Sources: The World of Tom Clancy's The Division, Tom Clancy's The Division Lore Book Preview

lower manhattan

4. Return to Lower Manhattan

Warlords of New York begins after a new Lower Manhattan biological attack. The four lieutenant mission records are campaign threads, so the archive does not falsely impose one universal internal order; the captured Liberty Island segment is marked as the end of the recorded run.

  1. Play

    Warlords of New York

    Major expansion spoilers

    Follow the Lower Manhattan attack into the Keener manhunt. The archive tracks Pathway Park, The Tombs, Stranded Tanker and Wall Street as parallel campaign records before the final Liberty Island segment.

    Archive records: Lower Manhattan Biological Attack · Warlords of New York Manhunt · Pathway Park · The Tombs · Stranded Tanker · Wall Street · Liberty Island

    Sources: Warlords of New York Expansion Overview, The Division 2 Realism Mode Hardcore | Complete NYC Walkthrough | No Fast Travel [2026]

operation crossroads

5. Operation: Crossroads

This is a confirmed internal novel sequence set after The Division 2. The sources establish book order, but not an exact placement against every later game expansion or season, so it remains a separate post-game branch.

  1. Read

    Recruited → Compromised → Hunted

    Increasing major spoilers across the trilogy

    Read Thomas Parrott's Operation: Crossroads novels in published series order: Maira Kanhai's Washington entry, the Gulf Coast refinery crisis, then the Albuquerque-focused Hunted operation.

    Archive records: Tom Clancy's The Division: Recruited · Tom Clancy's The Division: Compromised · Tom Clancy's The Division: Hunted

    Sources: Tom Clancy's The Division: Recruited, Tom Clancy's The Division: Compromised, Tom Clancy's The Division: Hunted
